Implementation landed through Gerrit change 2508.

RCA: the failed run combined `GERRIT_REFSPEC=refs/changes/66/2466/1` (patchset 1, `d6c37680805fc8ae013832dd4c09c1fb100a1e0b`) with `GERRIT_PATCHSET_REVISION=a22257e7d10e3d079ee676cbb38d2b39811d0fd5` (patchset 2/current). The pinned checkout action fetched and checked out `FETCH_HEAD` from the stale refspec, so the workflow reached the later fail-closed guard on the wrong commit. The guard was correct; the missing seam was deterministic refspec/revision validation before checkout.

Fix: `.github/workflows/jira-dc-exact-patchset.yml` now fetches the requested refspec from the GitHub mirror with a Gerrit fallback, validates `FETCH_HEAD^{commit}` equals `GERRIT_PATCHSET_REVISION`, and only then checks out the requested SHA and verifies `HEAD`; clear errors cover both unfetchable refspec and refspec/revision mismatch. `tests/unit/test_jira_dc_exact_patchset_workflow.py` executes the embedded checkout script against temporary git remotes and covers success, Gerrit fallback, stale-refspec mismatch, and unfetchable-refspec failure.

Evidence: Gerrit change 2508 merged at `a85cb4781845ccf0d8c0375adce9a01391ba4bc8` with `LLM-Review+1`, `Verified+1`, and zero unresolved comments. Verified run: https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/33592409853. Local targeted checks passed (`actionlint`, focused workflow/workflow-name/subprocess-env tests, `make lint`, `make typecheck`). The real Jira DC parity body was not dispatched locally because the real Data Center image only runs in CI; the checkout/verify plumbing is covered by static/runtime script tests and Gerrit gates.
